Based on the provided information, the VaxiQuick vaccine demonstrates a 70% efficacy rate against mild cases and an 85% efficacy rate against severe cases. It is considered suitable for all adult age groups, as the trials suggest consistent protection across this demographic. However, its ability to prevent the transmission of the disease to unvaccinated individuals has not been thoroughly studied, which is a limitation in its overall suitability for community-wide transmission control.
